statements:
CREATE TABLE product_deadline_queue (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  row_key UUID NOT NULL,
  use_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  at BIGINT NOT NULL,
  payload JSONB,
  state TEXT DEFAULT 'ready' NOT NULL,
  attempts INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  due_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  claim_expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  claim_token UUID,
  last_error TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  CONSTRAINT product_deadline_queue_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
COMMENT ON TABLE product_deadline_queue IS 'The deadlines Product''s behaviors arm, one message per row, use and deadline, due when it falls due (D103).'
steps.subject: table/product_deadline_queue

statements:
CREATE TABLE product_timers_deadlines (
  id UUID DEFAULT gen_random_uuid() NOT NULL,
  product_id UUID NOT NULL,
  "name" TEXT NOT NULL,
  base_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  armed_from TEXT,
  due_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  fired BOOLEAN,
  fired_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  outcome TEXT,
  CONSTRAINT product_timers_deadlines_pkey PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

COMMENT ON TABLE product_timers_deadlines IS 'One row per deadline started on the row, keyed by the deadline''s name: the time it starts from, the fact it started from, when it is due (null once until cancelled it), whether and when it fired, and what its then met.'
